# Argustack

> RAG engine for project intelligence — pull Jira, Git, GitHub into local Postgres, index codebases into Neo4j + Qdrant, then ask AI about your project. Includes a JetBrains IDE plugin with a kanban board where columns are Claude Code skills.

## What it does

CLI tool that downloads your project data into a local hub, then gives Claude / any LLM direct access via 46 MCP tools.

Seven sources of truth, each independent (own adapter, own use case, own subcommand):

- **Jira** — issues, comments, changelogs, worklogs, links
- **Jira Proxy** — Jira via corporate API gateway (bearer / bearer_exchange auth, configurable endpoints via `.argustack/proxy.json`)
- **Jira CSV** — import from CSV export for teams without API access
- **Git** — commits, per-file diffs, issue cross-references (multi-repo supported)
- **GitHub** — PRs, reviews, comments, releases
- **External DB** — schema introspection + read-only SQL against your app database
- **Code** — tree-sitter AST → Neo4j call graph + Qdrant vectors. Default embedding provider is **Ollama** (`nomic-embed-text`, 768d, MIT). LM Studio (Qwen3-Embedding-4B, Apache-2.0) and Voyage AI (`voyage-code-3`, cloud) are opt-ins.

All data stays on localhost in one shared `~/.argustack/` Docker stack (Postgres + Neo4j + Qdrant + pgweb). Multi-tenant: every row carries `workspace_id`, isolated by FK CASCADE. Nothing leaves your machine unless you opt into Voyage AI or OpenAI embeddings.

## How users interact

```bash
npm i -g argustack
argustack init                                  # bootstrap the hub (one-time)
argustack workspace add my-project              # create a workspace
argustack add <source> --workspace my-project … # bind jira / git / github / csv / db / code
argustack sync --workspace my-project           # pull all bound sources
argustack code index --project my-project       # build code graph + vectors
argustack mcp install                           # connect to Claude Desktop / Claude Code
```

Non-interactive mode: `argustack init --no-interactive --name my-project --skip-llm`, then bind sources via `argustack add <source> …`. Full command list, flags, init decision flow, and MCP tool reference live in **AGENTS.md** — that is the SSOT for technical detail.

After sync, Claude queries your data via 46 MCP tools (32 project-data + 14 code-intel). Every tool advertises `title` + `readOnly/destructive/idempotent/openWorld` annotations so Claude Desktop can warn before write operations. The server ships `instructions` describing workspace resolution order (explicit arg > `ARGUSTACK_WORKSPACE_ID` > active pointer > single-workspace auto-pick). `list_workspaces` and `find_symbol` return machine-readable `structuredContent` validated against an `outputSchema`.

## MCP tool groups

- **Workspace / Jira / Git / GitHub** — query_issues, query_commits, query_prs, query_releases, get_issue, issue_timeline, list_workspaces, switch_workspace, …
- **Cross-source** — issue_timeline (changelogs + commits + PRs for one issue), hybrid_search (keyword + optional pgvector semantic)
- **Prediction** — estimate (two predictions: with/without bugs, based on similar tasks and developer coefficient)
- **Write** — create_issue, update_issue, push (mode=create or updates), pull_jira
- **External DB** — db_schema, db_query, db_stats
- **Knowledge Graph** — impact_analysis, developer_expertise, related_issues, code_dependencies, business_context, root_cause_analysis, build_business_graph, add_relationship, add_observation
- **Code Graph (Neo4j)** — find_symbol, get_dependencies, get_dependents, get_callers, get_callees, get_call_path, find_arch_violations, find_unused_exports, get_implementers, get_layer_symbols
- **Code Semantic (Qdrant)** — search_semantic, find_similar_code
- **Code Hybrid** — explain_feature (4-stage), plan_feature_files (layered)

Full tool table with annotations and notes on `structuredContent` → **AGENTS.md → MCP Tool Reference**.

## Architecture — Hexagonal (Ports & Adapters)

```
src/core/types/    — Domain types, zero deps
src/core/ports/    — Interfaces (ISourceProvider, IStorage, IWorkspaceStore, ICodeGraph, ICodeVectorStore, ICodeParser, ICodeMetaStore, ICodeEmbedding, ILspClient, IDockerControl, IOllamaControl, IPlatformProbe, …)
src/adapters/      — jira/, jira-proxy/, git/, github/, csv/, db/, board/, postgres/, openai/, ollama/, lmstudio/, voyage/, neo4j/, qdrant/, tree-sitter/, lsp/, docker/, platform/
src/use-cases/     — PullUseCase, PushUseCase, EmbedUseCase, BuildGraphUseCase, Register/IndexCodeUseCase, CodeSearchUseCase, MigrateToHubUseCase, init/ building blocks
src/code-intel/    — Indexer, watcher, resolver, lsp-resolver, ranker, chunker, file-discovery, layer-detector, hash, tsconfig-paths, job-lock
src/workspace/     — hub-config.ts, active-workspace.ts, registry.ts (legacy migration only)
src/cli/           — Composition root: init/, workspace/, add/, sync.ts, status.ts, code.ts, mcp-install.ts, migrate-to-hub.ts, …
src/mcp/           — 46 tools, instructions, dynamic version, ANNOTATIONS presets
```

Dependency rule: `cli/,mcp/ → use-cases/ → core/ports` ← `adapters/`. Full file map in **AGENTS.md**.

## Hub layout (one stack, many workspaces)

- `~/.argustack/docker-compose.yml` — Postgres + Neo4j + Qdrant + pgweb on ports `15432..15437` (exotic to avoid clashes)
- `~/.argustack/.env` — port assignments
- `~/.argustack/config.env` — credentials + embedding provider (chmod 600)
- `~/.argustack/active-workspace.json` — pointer to the current workspace

Postgres schema has a `workspaces` parent table; every tenant table FK-CASCADEs on `workspace_id`. `code_projects.id === workspaces.id` is enforced by CHECK so MCP code tools resolve project from workspace without joins.

## Key design decisions

- **Multi-tenant hub** (ARG-264) — one stack, many workspaces, isolation by FK CASCADE
- **Download ALL fields from Jira** (`fields=*all`) + store raw JSON in `raw_json` JSONB
- **AsyncGenerator streaming** for large datasets (100k+ issues)
- **Pluggable embedding provider** — Ollama (default) / LM Studio / Voyage / custom OpenAI-compatible, selected via `CODE_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER` in `~/.argustack/config.env`
- **Markdown-to-ADF** auto-conversion when pushing issues to Jira
- **`argustack code init` is deprecated** — `argustack init` bootstraps the whole hub
- ESM modules, TypeScript strict mode, Vitest
